# Försvarsindustrins nästa kapitel

**Feed**: placerapodden  
**Published**: 2026-07-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Defense analyst Martin Boldt-Christmas discusses momentum in Ukraine and the defense sector, noting that large listed primes like Rheinmetall and Saab have sold off this year as budget growth gets priced in and order losses hit sentiment, while private defense-tech and AI startups (Anduril, Helsing, Stark) are raising capital at high valuations, mostly in the US. He also touches on the upcoming KNDS IPO, Palantir's controversial role and falling share price, European AI/space competitiveness versus the US, and geopolitical themes including Iran, oil, gold and China's quiet expansion.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RHM — Rheinmetall | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock down ~40% YTD after a lost frigate order; defense budget growth already largely priced in, creating both risk and long-run tailwind.

#### Reasoning

The guest frames the 2026 selloff in Rheinmetall as the market digesting already-known defense budget increases plus a concrete negative catalyst (a lost large order on frigates), rather than a structural change in the defense buildup thesis. No explicit buy/sell call is made, but the framing implies watching for further order flow and budget execution before re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- Further large order losses
- European defense budget growth stalling or being delayed
- No recovery in order backlog over coming quarters

> *"Om man tittar på Rheinmetall, den är ner nästan 40% i år. Bara då en 20% nu i dagarna egentligen när de förlorade en stor order på frigatter."*

---

### 🟠 SAAB-B — Saab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 5-10% in 2026, same dynamic as Rheinmetall of budget growth expectations already priced into the shares.

#### Reasoning

Grouped together with Rheinmetall as a large European defense prime whose share price has pulled back this year even as European defense budgets are set to rise toward the trillion-euro range in coming years, suggesting near-term valuation digestion rather than a change in the long-term structural growth story.

#### Sell Triggers

- European defense budget increases fail to materialize as expected
- Continued share price weakness despite rising order backlog

> *"Det är samma sak med Sabe, väl ner också kanske 5-10 procent i år."*

---

### 🟠 PLTR — Palantir | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Share price roughly halved from $200 to $110 after a period seen as overvalued; remains a leading but controversial AI/defense name.

#### Reasoning

The guest notes Palantir was significantly overvalued for a time and the stock has since corrected sharply, while also flagging governance/dependence concerns from allied governments relying on a single large US company for defense and civil infrastructure software, which could pressure its European growth ambitions even as autonomy/AI remains a key long-term theme.

#### Sell Triggers

- European governments moving to reduce reliance on Palantir for sovereignty reasons
- Further valuation compression if AI/defense software growth slows

> *"Antal palantir är väl det stora där men samtidigt deras aktier faller från 200 dollar till 110."*

---
